# Your home network, now

> A live, read-only map of Joel's home network, floor by floor: each
> eero with how busy its radios are, every device on it with its address
> and signal, the switch, the modem and the internet, and each device's
> route to the internet with where it runs out of room.

- [The page](index.html): the map, walked by keyboard or pointer, with
  each device's details and every device as a tree beside it.
- [The page as text](index.md): how to read the map, its keys, and what
  the data holds.
- The data: net's records of the network, which the page watches live
  over the sites' server at /feed/net. An agent on the machine runs
  `net --json` itself.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
